text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet achieved spectacular results 
in the Twinkle Series, truly worthy of the 
"Number One Umamusume."

Having completed those truly precious 
"first three years," she now takes her 
first steps onto a brand-new path—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
……It's already been 3 years, huh. Feels 
kind of strange.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So, how was it? What's it feel like 
standing next to the number one Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll let you know just in case, as a 
matter of courtesy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because you were there, I could run all 
the way through. Because you were there, I 
was able to become number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this is giving me the creeps! Stop, 
stop!! A gloomy mood doesn't suit us at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, get back to work already! You've 
got a packed schedule starting tomorrow, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well then, see ya later! Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you, really. I'm glad you're my 
Trainer."
